cohort: 12 patients diagnosed with CSP between December 2012 and June 2016 at a tertiary care hospital in Toronto, Canada
finding: This study suggests that CSP can be safely and effectively managed using a surgical algorithm that tailors the approach (laparoscopic or transcervical) to the characteristics of the CSP, as surgical management resulted in complete resolution of CSP with no complications in this case series.
gest_age: First trimester (mean GA at presentation was 8+1 weeks)
